Loss report: gitea -> gitlab
[external] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner: no tag (the hosted label ubuntu-latest runs on any Linux worker; the GitHub-hosted image tools are not present)
[external] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.env: create GITEA_DEPLOY, GITHUB_TOKEN as a masked CI/CD variable in the project settings, protected too for protected branches (a GitLab file cannot mark a secret as one; it writes GITEA_DEPLOY, GITHUB_TOKEN as plain variable references and the operator sets the values there)
